arStrings.szText: "Lilith is no longer in the Void. Elias' ritual would not work to bring her back."
Don’t you know everything. Elias’ ritual was only the foundation for my work. I am going to dedicate my life to this. To bring our Mother back.
"Don’t you know everything." - insulting and sarcastic
But there are other things in the Void. Things that should never be known. The traitors don’t know what they are messing with.
